I sit down and think about this year. Last year cotton gave me okay money but the price is uncertain. Maize is steadier — I can sell or feed it. I have 7 mu, just me and my wife at home, the children work in town. So I cannot do too much heavy work alone.

I will put 4 mu in cotton and 3 mu in spring maize. Cotton needs more hand work — picking, spraying for bollworm — but the price per mu is better when it works out. Maize is easier, the harvester comes through the village.

For maize, last year I used about 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) as base, around 50 jin each, then top-dressed with urea at jointing. That comes to roughly 22 kg N, 7 kg P, 7 kg K per mu. I will do the same — neighbors got 550-600 kg/mu and I did about the same. Rotary till before sowing, that is what the village machine does. Hybrid seed from the dealer in town — Zhengdan or Xianyu type, everyone uses it. Two irrigations from my well: one after sowing if dry, one at tasseling. One spray for borer is usually enough.

For cotton, I use less N because too much makes it grow tall with no bolls. About 15 kg N, 7 kg P, 8 kg K. Cotton needs potassium for the bolls. I will spray 6 times — bollworm, aphids, spider mites come every year, no skipping. Improved seed, Bt cotton, that is standard now. Three irrigations through the season. Plough for cotton — deeper roots need it. I expect 250 kg seed cotton per mu, that is what I usually get.
